mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT( create_time, "%Y-%m-%d" ) as `day`, views_count FROM `tb_unique_view` WHERE create_time > #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} ORDER BY create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_unique_view (views_count, create_time) VALUES (#{viewsCount}, #{createTime}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE views_count = new.views_count, update_time = NOW()
INSERT IGNORE INTO tb_site_visitor (view_date, visitor_hash, area, created_at) VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, #{visitorHash}, #{area}, NOW())
INSERT INTO tb_unique_view (views_count, create_time) VALUES (1, CURRENT_DATE) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE views_count = views_count + 1, update_time = NOW()
